problem:
An inner product on $V={R}^{3}$ is defined as $⟨x,y⟩={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+4{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+7{x}_{3}{y}_{3}.$ 
Calculate the norm of the vector $v=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ under this inner product.
worked_solution:
The norm of a vector $v$ with respect to an inner product $⟨\cdot ,\cdot ⟩$ is defined as

$$
\begin{aligned}‖v‖=\sqrt{⟨v,v⟩}.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $‖v‖$ using our definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖v‖ & =\sqrt{⟨v,v⟩} \\  & =\sqrt{3\cdot 3+4\cdot ((-2)\cdot (-2))+7\cdot (0\cdot 0)} \\  & =\sqrt{9+16} \\  & =\sqrt{25} \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
